note: sakura-suzuhara (Sakura Suzuhara) — SMG/Water/Supporter/Burst I, cd 40s, ammo 120, hitsPerShot 1, RL 5.7. NOT base `sakura` (SR/Fire) and NOT `sakura-bloom-in-summer` (AR/Wind) — distinct units; lint-disambiguated. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-04, test-first (scripts/tests/units/sakura-suzuhara.test.ts). A pure support/healer whose ONLY damage-relevant line is S1's boss debuff; the rest of the kit is healing/mitigation the v1 sim models as recovery-event cadence (burst) or not at all (skill2). AUDIT (4 kit lines): (L1) S1 '■ Activates after landing 120 normal attacks. Affects the target(s). Damage Taken ▲ 17.18% for 5 sec.' → hitCount count:120, target enemy, buff {stat:damageTakenPct, value:17.18, durationSec:5}. LOAD-BEARING: the engine's ONLY damageTakenPct channel is the boss debuff (positive = boss takes MORE; sim.ts dmgTakenSum → taken multiplier) and the kit's 'Damage Taken ▲ on the target' is exactly that — it amplifies ALL team damage while up. TRIGGER IDENTITY: hitCount (cumulative landed rounds), NOT lastBullet — the two coincide at base (ammo 120) but the prose says 'after landing 120 normal attacks', and lastBullet would silently diverge under any ammo/reload modifier. CADENCE: 120 hits = exactly one magazine dump (ammo 120, hitsPerShot 1) ≈ 5.0s of 1440rpm fire + 81f reload ≈ 6.35s per cycle; the 5s duration lapses ~1.35s before each refresh (~79% uptime), and the KR same-slot overwrite rule means each proc REFRESHES the one debuff (never co-stacks). Pinned: value 17.18, 5s wall-clock expiry, boss-held (targetIdx null; the enemy-branch applyBuff passes no casterIdx, so owner attribution rides on the buff key), count === floor(shots/120), first apply > t=0, team damage drops when removed, and a passive always-on counterfactual moves both count and total. (L2/L3) both skill2 lines UNMODELED — see unmodeled + caveats. (L4) burst 'Emergency Healing': '■ Affects 2 ally unit(s) with the lowest HP percentage. Recovers 10.03% of the skill user's final Max HP every 1 sec for 10 sec.' → burstCast, target alliesLowestHp count:2, heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1. The engine's heal effect carries NO HP amount (v1 has no HP pool) — the modeled substance is the RECOVERY-EVENT CADENCE (helm H2 precedent 'a heal is an event, not a number'; the HoT encoding keeps on-recovery consumers refreshed across the whole 10s window — the type comment's own example shape). Damage-inert but OBSERVABLE: 10 recovery ticks per cast drive teammate recovery triggers (pinned via crown's 20.99 recovery buff in the fixture). TRIGGER IDENTITY: burstCast (HER cast), never fullBurstEnter — pinned in the B1-contention arm vs liter. TIER 2 (hitCount round-count trigger + burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter identity + enemy-debuff duration window). EVIDENCE TIER: every magnitude/duration is kit-text-literal (17.18/5, 15.18/10, 14.97/10, 10.03%/1s/10s); conventions are the boss-debuff channel read for 'Damage Taken ▲ on target', the leftmost-2 alliesLowestHp stand-in (⚑ in caveats), and the recovery-cadence modeling of heals (all flagged). Faithful>fit; measured>fudge. || Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-04.

skill2:
■ Activates after landing 60 normal attacks. Affects the 2 ally unit(s) with the lowest HP percentage.
Incoming healing ▲ 15.18% for 10 sec.

■ Activates after landing 120 normal attacks. Affects the 2 ally unit(s) with the lowest HP percentage.
Damage Taken ▼ 14.97% for 10 sec.

caveats: skill1: 'Damage Taken ▲ 17.18%' on the target is the boss-facing damageTakenPct debuff (positive = boss takes MORE — the channel's documented polarity), NOT an ally attack buff and NOT the mirror of skill2's 'Damage Taken ▼'. KR stacking rule: same caster slot/stat/value OVERWRITES/refreshes across procs — one debuff instance, re-applied every 120th landed round (her full magazine), 5s duration vs ~6.35s mag cycle ≈ 79% uptime with a ~1.35s gap per cycle.

skill2 (Incoming healing ▲ 15.18% / 10s): UNMODELED verbatim — v1's heal effects carry no HP amount and the schema has no healing-received stat (validate-overrides STATS), so the amplifier multiplies nothing; damage-neutral. Nearest-wrong rejected: encoding it as a 'heal' effect every 60 hits would spuriously emit recovery events at SMG cadence and feed on-recovery consumers (crown-class kits) — a massive over-credit. It is a stat buff on the recipients, not a heal; pinned silent by the spec's negative assertions.

skill2 (Damage Taken ▼ 14.97% / 10s) ⚑ engine-core / out-of-domain: ally received-damage mitigation; v1 models no ally HP pool and no incoming boss damage, so it can never move anything here. ESTIMATE: in a real fight this is a meaningful survivability window on the 2 lowest-HP allies once per mag dump (~15% less damage taken for 10s) — damage-neutral in this sim. The boss-facing damageTakenPct channel is the WRONG direction/target — encoding it (as +14.97 or −14.97 on the boss) would manufacture a phantom team damage change on the exact same 120-hit frame as skill1, so it is NOT used (noise precedent). RECIPE: add an engine ally-HP-pool + incoming-boss-damage model and an ally received-damage-reduction stat (distinct from the boss-facing damageTakenPct debuff), then encode on hitCount:120 to alliesLowestHp count:2. TIER: engine-core (new primitive), out-of-domain for the no-incoming-damage v1 sim.

burst: the heal is recovery-EVENT cadence only — the 10.03%-of-caster-final-Max-HP magnitude is inherently unmodeled (no HP pool); only the window shape is kit-literal ('every 1 sec for 10 sec' → ticks:10 intervalSec:1, the type comment's documented HoT shape; helm precedent). The burst has NO damage component (datamined ulti skill_type SetBuff, no hurt values) and is damage-inert; its observable is the recovery stream driving teammate 'recovery' triggers.

burst: target alliesLowestHp count:2 resolves to the LEFTMOST-2 allies (documented v1 stand-in — no HP pool, 'lowest HP percentage' is indeterminate; types.ts). ⚑ in a real fight the heal lands on whoever is actually lowest; an on-recovery consumer only stays refreshed if it is among the real 2 targets. ESTIMATE: bounded by the consumer's buff value × the 10s window per cast; zero consequence in a comp with no recovery consumer. RECIPE: any sakura-suzuhara focus recording — read which 2 units the heal popups land on vs their HP bars. TIER: low (only moves comps that stack a recovery consumer).

skill1 ⚑ hit-count semantics (cross-family S6 flag, reconciled): the engine's hitCount accrues FIRED rounds × hitsPerShot (sim.ts hitCounters), the repo convention for 'after landing N normal attacks'; in-game SMG spread means landed ≤ fired, so the real activation can lag the sim's and the debuff duty cycle is slightly over-credited. ESTIMATE: bounded by the miss fraction over 120 rounds vs the immobile scope-lock-style boss (high hit rate; the lag is a fraction of one mag cycle, not a re-phase). RECIPE (S6): focus-record her in a graded comp and measure the interval between consecutive Damage Taken ▲ applications on the boss vs the magazine boundaries off the ammo counter — at the reload = fired-count correct; lagging into the next mag = raise count by the observed landing fraction. TIER: medium — her entire team contribution is this debuff's uptime, so a cadence error scales it 1:1.

cadence tuple ⚑ (always-⚑): pullsPerSec is the engine-default SMG cadence (datamined rate_of_fire 1440 fired on 60fps frame boundaries), reloadFrames 81, ammo 120 — unmodified by this override. Both live and unmodeled triggers are hit-count-keyed, so any cadence error propagates 1:1 into the S1 debuff duty cycle. RECIPE: read shots/sec + reload gap from any focus recording. TIER: standard.
